"""RoboPaint 月. Camera-calibrated brush trajectories, with recorded actions.
Run recorded action files only on a fresh authorized episode; this episode is permanent.
"""
import sys,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output'); RUNS=Path('/app/runs')
Q=[0.,1.,0.,0.]
ZP=.0202
S=.227185/1024

def pose(x,y,z): return [x,y,z,*Q]
def pix(u,v,z): return pose(-.1+(512-v-.5)*S,(512-u-.5)*S,z)
class Painter:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot(); self.last=self.r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam'],video='none').group('tcp_pose',now=True).tolist()
 def send(self,rows,name,dt=.05,cams=['practice_cam','canvas_cam'],fps=5):
  rows=np.asarray(rows)
  idx=len(list(ROOT.glob('action_*.npz')))
  np.savez(ROOT/f'action_{idx:03}_{name}.npz',actions=rows,dt=dt)
  res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=dt,cameras=cams,video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=name)
  res.save(str(RUNS/f'{idx:03}_{name}'))
  for c,im in res.last.items():
   from PIL import Image
   Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/f'{c}.png')
  self.last=res.group('tcp_pose',now=True).tolist()
  print(name,'tip',self.last[:3],'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'remaining',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
  return res
 def move(self,p,name='move',speed=.06,hold=.3):
  n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p[:3])-self.last[:3])/speed/.05)))
  a=np.linspace(self.last,p,n+1)[1:].tolist()+[p]*int(hold/.05)
  for i in range(0,len(a),180): self.send(a[i:i+180],name)
 def dip(self):
  self.move(pose(self.last[0],self.last[1],.07),'lift')
  self.move(pose(-.1,.185,.07),'ink_above')
  self.move(pose(-.1,.185,.023),'dip',speed=.025,hold=.5)
  self.move(pose(-.1,.185,.07),'ink_lift')
if __name__=='__main__':

 p.move(pose(-.1,.19,.10),'inspect')
 o=p.r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam','canvas_cam','practice_cam'],depth=True);o.save('/app/runs/clear')

from gen import *
from design import paths,dense_path
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d
# Advance the brush tip relative to the mark centre to compensate for hair deflection.
def trajectory(P,shift=(0,0),speed=.009,lead=1.3):
 a=dense_path(P,.6)
 xy=np.array([pix(u,v,ZP)[:2] for u,v,_ in a])+np.array(shift)
 tangent=np.gradient(xy,axis=0);tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None]
 width=2*a[:,2]*S*1000
 dep=(width+.8)/1.18/1000
 tip=xy+tangent*dep[:,None]*lead
 xyz=np.c_[tip,ZP-dep]
 # Time samples at approximately constant centreline speed.
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1))/speed]
 tt=np.arange(0,t[-1],.05)
 traj=np.c_[interp1d(t,xyz,axis=0)(tt),np.tile(Q,(len(tt),1))]
 traj=np.vstack([traj,[*xyz[-1],*Q]])
 return traj

def stroke(p,P,name,shift=(0,0),speed=.009,lead=1.3):
 a=trajectory(P,shift,speed,lead)
 start=a[0].copy();start[2]=.045
 p.move(start.tolist(),name+'_above')
 # Descend at the narrow starting point.
 start[2]=ZP+.001;p.move(start.tolist(),name+'_ready',speed=.015,hold=.1)
 # Include the downward entry in the moving trajectory.
 for i in range(0,len(a),180):p.send(a[i:i+180],name+f'_{i}')
 end=a[-1].copy();end[2]=.04;p.move(end.tolist(),name+'_lift',speed=.025,hold=.2)
if __name__=='__main__':
 p=Painter();p.dip()
 from PIL import Image
 o=p.r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam']);Image.fromarray(o.last['practice_cam']).save('/app/output/before_stroke1_practice.png')
 stroke(p,paths[0],'practice_s1',shift=(0,-.195),lead=1.3)

 o=p.r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam']);Image.fromarray(o.last['practice_cam']).save('/app/output/after_stroke1_practice.png')
